description: Variation of condition 6 (Energy) of planning permission P/2018/2430 approved 03/09/2018 Erection of a first and second floor rear extension to provide two self contained flats at the rear of the building.
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Reason: To accord with the provisions of Section 92 (1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [Daylight Report 170/JN, 468-PL02-042, 468-PL02-041, 468-PL02-031, PL02-002, 468/PL02-001, Unnumbered Design and Access Statement, 468-00-003, 468-00-001, 02-031, 468-PL02-023, 468-PL02-022, 468-PL02-21, 02-002, 02-001, 02-021, 468-PL02-003, 468-PL02-004. Received 02/07/2018, Energy Statement received 03/03/2025].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of
the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without
the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Reason: To protect neighbours' living conditions and to ensure that the accommodation provided is appropriate and respects the character and appearance of the area in accordance with Policy SC7 Residential extensions and alterations of the adopted Local Plan.

Condition : 4 - Development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the external material details approved on 17/09/2020 under planning reference P/2020/2413.
Reason: In order that the Council may be satisfied as to the details of the development in the interests of the visual amenity of the area and to satisfy the requirements of policies CC1 Context and character and CC2 Urban Design and Architecture of the adopted Local Plan.

Condition : 5 - Demolition or construction works shall take place only between 0800 -1800 on Mondays to Fridays, 0900 � 1300 on Saturdays and shall not take place at any time on Sundays or on Bank or Public Holidays.
Reason: In order to prevent undue disturbance to neighbours in accordance with Local Plan policies CC1 and CC2

Condition : 6 - The development hereby permitted shall be implemented in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy (Flats 4 & 5, 172 High Street TW3 1BQ, ENERGY STATEMENT produced by Dynamic Energy Assessors dated 29/12/2023)

Reason: To ensure that the development makes the fullest contribution to minimising carbon dioxide emissions in accordance with the London Plan and the London Borough of Hounslow Local Plan Policy EQ1.

Condition : 7 - Development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the details approved on 25/07/2023 under planning reference P/2023/2048.

Reason: In the interests of sustainability and to ensure the satisfactory management of surface water run-off from the development hereby permitted, including by preventing increased risk of flooding and pollution of the water environment, and in accordance with adopted Local Plan policy EQ3 (Flood Risk and Surface Water Management) and the London Plan.

Condition : 8 - The development shall be designed so that Internal water consumption shall not exceed 105 l/p/day for each flat, in line with The Water Efficiency Calculator for new dwellings from the Department of Communities and Local Government.

Reason: In the interests of sustainability and to accord with the London Plan.

Condition : 9 - Development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the sustainable sourcing of materials approved on 28/11/2022 under planning reference P/2022/2685.

Reason: In order to ensure the sustainable sourcing of materials in accordance with the London Plan.

Condition : 10 - Development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the landscape approved on 31/10/2023 under planning reference P/2023/2936.

Reason:  To protect the appearance of the area in accordance with Local Plan policies CC1 and CC2

Condition : 11 - Development shall be carried out in strict accordance with the cycle storage approved on 14/03/2023 under planning reference P/2023/0049.

Reason: To promote sustainable modes of transport in accordance with the London Plan.
